text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins today.
The Umamusume board the bus heading
for the academy's special facility.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My bus group is next!
I'll go on ahead, okay?!
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry. I can't go with you.
Yeah, sorry. I can't go with you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: N-No, no! It takes paperwork for a teacher to accompany us, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for troubling both of you on my account.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let's continue the off-campus guest application over there...
choice_data_list: Ah, yes! Tsuyoshi, see you later then!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san.
Let's meet at the venue~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
See you both later—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...? Grass~, what's the matter, yes~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...No?
By the way, El, about the bus seating arrangements~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, mind if I take the seat next to you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Grass!?
Wait, then who's next to me...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I had El take over for me~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If you endure patiently, the next season will come.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Grass-chan was injured in the spring, too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Frustrated, helpless, and bitter.
She should have been able to run so much better."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Even if that thought crosses your mind.
No matter how wide the gap has grown."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Because both you and I have decided to keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan...
...—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...El-san. Scoot over to the edge.
King can't sit down.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —I know you're curious, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"We're heeeere! Whew~ it's boiling hot~"
"Let's get inside quick! Hope the A/C is on~"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. This humid, sticky heat really feels quintessential Japan, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
If you don't stay hydrated, it really takes a toll on your body...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey Grass-chan!
But I—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... Me?
Why... What was she going to say—)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, n-no! Nothing at all!
I'm looking forward to the training camp, Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Sorry! Passing through!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Kikuka Sho' is a long-distance 3,000m race in Kyoto.
It's the longest distance among the Classic GⅠs, and bound to be the most grueling race.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I need to build up the stamina for that.
There's no time to dilly-dally. I must take this seriously――!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hic... Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Gotta ventilate, ventilate...
Dust is the ultimate enemy of health, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... Ahh... the breeze is so cool—...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Grass!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You were indeed injured.
You must have felt frustrated and bitter.
And had things you wished you could say!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, the impact you made in the Junior Class is etched into El's mind!
That strength is burned into my eyes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be waiting for you!
On the ultimate stage, beyond all generations!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So bright...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (That's how it was, wasn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. Grass-chan was
last year's Best Junior Umamusume, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(A record-breaking win in the GⅠ they entered.
A 'second-generation monster,' standing shoulder to shoulder with great seniors.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(So even if I'm injured,
even if I can't run in races—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—They're waiting. They've been longing for this.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (That she will "definitely" make a comeback.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's why, with me—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: …………――And who might I be, hmm~~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: N-Noooo! What is with this mouth of mine! Moving on its own like that~! You're part of my body, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: You've been doing this the whole time... Geesh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...!
U-Um! Tsuru-ch—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Special Week.
What were you planning to say to them?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Um...
Since we're friends, I just asked, "Are you okay?"...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Then let us stop. It seems
it is no longer able to... answer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Spe-chan.
More importantly, help me out here~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We don't have enough people for Daifugo~.
Come on, pretty please? Hey, hey~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...King, you too~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'll catch up later.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Even though you won't talk to her?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even if a mistake was made, position-wise I'm on that side too. ...In that case, all we can do is wait.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No matter which path we choose,
we can only move forward on our own two feet."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Always making such plausible excuses~
...Good grief, you're far too kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Meeen-min-min-min...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I step off the bus, arms full of heavy luggage.
This summer, I will make sure she doesn't get injured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whoever conquers the summer conquers the autumn season.
There are still Classic races left.
The final one, the Kikuka Sho—...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
――Ah.
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Classic-class summer training camp began.
